text:
The current meeting accepts shareholder votes on the resolutions.

Advance registration for voting is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
A minimum holding of 500 shares to exercise voting rights is expressly not required for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Delivery of a power-of-attorney instrument is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Recall of securities on loan before voting is expressly not required for this vote.
Blocking of the voted securities is expressly not required for this vote.
A prohibition on splitting votes between opposing directions is expressly not required for this vote.
A certificate confirming the holding is expressly not required for this vote.
Disclosure of the beneficial owner's identity is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.

text:

A certificate confirming the holding is expressly not required for this vote.
Recall of securities on loan before voting is mandatory for this vote.
Disclosure of the beneficial owner's identity is mandatory for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

text:
The current meeting accepts shareholder votes on the resolutions.

A prohibition on splitting votes between opposing directions is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.

Recall of securities on loan before voting is mandatory for this vote.
A certificate confirming the holding is expressly not required for this vote.
Advance registration for voting is expressly not required for this vote.
Disclosure of the beneficial owner's identity is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Blocking of the voted securities is expressly not required for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Advance registration for voting is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Delivery of a power-of-attorney instrument is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Blocking of the voted securities is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.

Advance registration for voting is expressly not required for this vote.

text:
The current meeting accepts shareholder votes on the resolutions.

Recall of securities on loan before voting is expressly not required for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A certificate confirming the holding is mandatory for this vote.
Delivery of a power-of-attorney instrument is expressly not required for this vote.
Blocking of the voted securities is mandatory for this vote.
A minimum holding of 500 shares to exercise voting rights is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Disclosure of the beneficial owner's identity is mandatory for this vote.
Advance registration for voting is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
A prohibition on splitting votes between opposing directions is expressly not required for this vote.

text:
The current meeting accepts shareholder votes on the resolutions.

Recall of securities on loan before voting is mandatory for this vote.
Advance registration for voting is expressly not required for this vote.
A prohibition on splitting votes between opposing directions is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Blocking of the voted securities is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
Delivery of a power-of-attorney instrument is expressly not required for this vote.
Disclosure of the beneficial owner's identity is available voluntarily and is not a voting prerequisite.
A minimum holding of 500 shares to exercise voting rights is expressly not required for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A certificate confirming the holding is expressly not required for this vote.
